## Profile

Senior data science and modeling professional specializing in forecasting, time series, and applied statistical modeling. Experienced in developing quantitative solutions from complex, high-frequency, alternative, and unstructured data, and in translating analytical results into information for high-stakes decision-making.

Currently leads the Data Science and Modeling team at Kapitalo. Combines methodological depth and technical leadership with the practical engineering capabilities required to build reproducible pipelines, analytical applications, and continuously updated data products.

## Areas of Expertise

**Modeling:** Forecasting · Econometrics · Machine Learning · State-Space Models · Bayesian Inference

**Data:** Alternative and Unstructured Data · High-Frequency Data · Web Data

**Tools & Delivery:** R · SQL · Python · DuckDB · PostgreSQL · APIs · Git · Reproducible Pipelines · Automated Reporting · Dashboards · Web Applications

## Publication

Author of [*R for Economic Research*](https://book.rleripio.com), a practical guide to data workflows, statistical modeling, time series, and forecasting for applied research. The book has received more than 50,000 views from readers in over 50 countries.
